messages:
raj: Heads up — Product just pushed an ask for an EU private pilot + dedicated capacity by early Nov. They want predictable latency for chat and embeddings. Need to revisit GPU mix and procurement timing. TL;DR: customer wants EU private with 95th pct <300ms and startup throughput ~500 req/s.

sophie: Is Nov shipping firm or a wishlist?

marie: Customer committed to a paid pilot if we can meet the SLA. PM request is Nov-ish. They can be flexible by ~4 weeks but revenue recognition prefers Q4.

tim: Big constraint: our committed budget for Q4 only covers ~60 H100-equivalent units if we go all H100s. A100s are ~40% cheaper per perf-dollar for inference workloads.

devin: Perf note: H100 shows 15-25% latency wins on long-context churn and better throughput for batching; embeddings heavy workload still cheaper on L4/A100. For chat with long histories H100 matters.

ops-bot: inventory-bot: current on-hand stock: H100: 12, A100: 64, L4: 80. Expected replenishment ETA: A100 6w, L4 4w, H100 12-16w (vendor).

raj: Proposal: hybrid procurement + partner leasing to meet Nov pilot. Order: 40 H100, 80 A100, 60 L4 (reserve 60% vs spot 40%). Short-term: partner lease 30 H100-equivalents in EU for first 8 weeks to meet pilot SLA.

sophie: Counterpoint — lead time for H100 makes 40 new H100s impossible for Nov unless we pay expedite premiums. Partner lease appears required. What's the delta on cost?

tim: Finance rough numbers: expedite H100 + logistics =~ $1.1M extra. Partner lease for 8 weeks =~ $180k. Lease seems much cheaper for short runway.

devin: Operational risk: cross-region KV cache warmup + higher cold-starts if we route EU traffic to leased cluster. We need a gating perf test and rollout criteria: 
- staging perf: 95th <300ms on synthetic mix (chat+embeds)
- warm-up ramp: KV hit rate >70% before production cutover
- fallback: quantized A100 variant with graceful degradation if latency spikes
Include small eval harness that mimics customer prompt churn.

marie: OKR alignment: Infra-OKR1 = "EU private pilot ready by Nov"; Product-OKR2 = "Pilot meets 95th<300ms and throughput>=500req/s for 2 weeks". If we can't meet both, PM recommends shifting pilot to Jan. That affects revenue timing.

raj: If we accept lease route, action items: 1) marie + tim: submit expedited procurement ask for a reduced H100 order (min 12) and finance justification; 2) sophie: negotiate partner lease (EU) and preflight contract terms; 3) devin: write perf gating scripts + run on partner cluster; 4) ops-bot: open ticket for capacity routing policy to include fallback and soft-SLA messaging. Agree?

tim: +1 :thumbsup: for lease + small H100 order. Finance prefers smaller capex now.

sophie: I'll ping 2 partners (colocated provider + cloud host) and share cost + SLA matrix by EOD Fri.

devin: I'll start drafting the perf harness tonight and put a PR in infra-tests repo with benchmarks + KV warmup scenario. Need access to partner nodes — sophie will share creds.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-2319 for H100 expedited procurement request; linked to INF-2320 (partner-lease-eval) and INF-2321 (perf-gating-spec).

marie: Let's sync Wed 10am PT to finalize numbers. If finance okays expedite, we'll lock orders same day. If not, plan is: partner lease -> pilot goes Nov with soft-SLA + contract clause; hard SLA only after owned capacity online.

raj: Also flag to Product: if pilot goes soft-SLA, add rollout note in roadmap and update the customer contract. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/infra-q4 (internal).

sophie: One more ask — please include utilization targets for Q4 in the decision: we should aim for fleet utilization 65-75% target across hosted+dedicated to hit cost OKR. If partner lease runs high, deduct from short-term utilization goal.

tim: Noted. I'll update the capacity spreadsheet with two scenarios (aggressive buy vs hybrid lease) and put expected utilization and unit cost per 1M tokens.

raj: Thanks all. Quick poll: reply with :+1: if you approve hybrid lease + small H100 order, :shrug: if you prefer delaying pilot.

marie: :+1:

sophie: :+1:

tim: :+1:

devin: :+1:

(End of thread)
